why: A complete, short post with one idea; must say it in one or two bullets without padding or the program promo at the top.
must_capture: Because AI has flooded inboxes with cold outreach, marketing copy now has to win on specificity: concrete detail builds trust and stands out (the 'Especially Earl' joke).
Be specific about the customer's Momentum (what they already do to solve the problem) and Quirk (the constraint that makes common solutions useless), not about your solution.
must_not_claim: The Tacklebox Membership program or any promotion.
A second bullet that restates the first or adds claims not in the email.
